title: n
Poppy's Picnic.
s1_a: Poppy the bunny is fast asleep. Tap the sun to wake her up!
p_wake: It's Bear's birthday! Let's make him a picnic!
s2_a: Bears love carrots. Pull up three carrots!
s2_b: Three crunchy carrots, in the basket!
s3_a: Which way shall we go? Through the forest, or past the pond?
s4a_a: Here is Owl, in a tree full of cherries. Shake the tree!
s4a_b: Four juicy cherries, in the basket!
o_join: A birthday picnic? May I come too?
s4b_a: Oh no! The stepping stones have floated away. Put them back!
s4b_b: Hop, hop, hop! Now pick three mushrooms.
s4b_c: Three little mushrooms, in the basket!
d_join: A birthday picnic? Can I come too? Quack!
g_hungry: Oh dear. My tummy is so rumbly.
s5_a: Pig is very hungry. Will you give Pig a carrot, or keep on hopping?
g_thanks: Yum! Thank you, Poppy! I will bring something special to the party.
s5_share: Poppy shared a carrot. What a kind bunny!
s6_a: This is Bear's house. Knock three times!
b_who: Who's that knocking at my door?
s7_a: Time for the picnic. Put the food on the blanket!
s7_cake: Look! Pig baked a birthday cake to say thank you. Light the candles!
s7_pig: Look who is peeking! Tap Pig. There is room for everyone.
b_wow: A picnic, for me? This is the best birthday ever!
s8_a: The moon is coming up. Tap the moon to say goodnight.
